mesh_oracle: crates/es-assets/tests/so101_provenance.rs::upstream_meshes_load_and_hash (--ignored) fetches each assets/*.stl at `commit` into target/menagerie/<commit>/, verifies its blake3 before parsing it, and decodes it with es_assets::stl. The 19 files together are 362,996 triangles. Nothing here is vendored: the derivative stays primitives-only, so the fixture's scene_hash is untouched by any of this.
license_source: robotstudio_so101/LICENSE at the pinned commit, unmodified
derivation: Carried over unchanged from upstream so101.xml: the body tree (base, shoulder, upper_arm, lower_arm, wrist, gripper, camera_mount, moving_jaw_so101_v1) with byte-equal `pos` and orientation; the six hinge joints (shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex, wrist_roll, gripper) with byte-equal `axis`, `range` and the `sts3215` class `damping`/`armature`/`frictionloss`; every `<inertial>` (mass and fullinertia); every primitive (non-mesh) geom with its `pos`, orientation and `size`; the six `<position>` actuators with their `kp`, `kv`, `forcerange` and `ctrlrange`; and `<option>` apart from one attribute listed below.

Dropped: every `type="mesh"` geom, together with `<asset>`, `meshdir` and `<material>`. A mesh geom is `PhysicsError::Unsupported` in crates/es-physics-backend/src/mjcf_out.rs and is refused by crates/es-render/src/scene.rs, so a mesh-bearing model reaches neither MuJoCo nor the renderer through this pipeline. The three `class="collision_gripper_mesh"` collision meshes are dropped without replacement: the jaws they cover are already described by the explicit box/sphere primitives of `class="collision_gripper"`, which are kept.

Added: one visual-only primitive (`contype=0 conaffinity=0`) per link, named `<link>_shell`, standing in for that link's dropped visual meshes. `camera_mount_shell` carries the 0.012 kg of the visual mesh it replaces, so the mount's mass is unchanged; every other link has an explicit `<inertial>`, which MuJoCo prefers over geom-derived inertia, so the added shells change no mass property.

Flattened: the upstream `class="so101"`/`"visual"`/`"collision"`/`"collision_gripper"`/`"collision_gripper_mesh"`/`"backlash"` default classes are gone; only `class="sts3215"` survives, and it carries only `<joint>` and `<position>` values. Attributes those classes supplied to geoms (`condim`, `friction`, `solref`, `rgba`, `mass`) are written out explicitly on each geom.

Not represented by SceneDesc, therefore removed so the fixture parses with zero warnings (crates/es-assets/src/mjcf/attrs.rs `report_unknown`): geom `group` and `priority`, site `group`, `<option ls_iterations>`, `<mesh maxhullvert>`, the whole `<visual>` section, and the `mode`/`resolution`/`sensorsize`/`focal` attributes of a `<camera>`. Dropping `priority="1"` from the gripper contact geoms means MuJoCo mixes contact parameters instead of letting the gripper win; `mjcf_out` cannot emit `priority` in any case.

Removed: the wrist camera `wrist_cam`, whose `mode`/`resolution`/`sensorsize`/`focal` attributes SceneDesc does not carry, and which the demo does not use -- `MultiViewPack` is rejected by crates/es-compile/src/plan.rs, so the demo has exactly one camera.

Added scene, not from upstream: a `table` ground plane; a `bin` of one floor plate and four thin walls (interior x in [0.090, 0.190], y in [-0.150, -0.050], floor top z = 0.008), placed beside the arm rather than in front of it -- at packet M5/V0's place, centred on the +X axis at x = 0.11, its near wall intersected the shoulder's own collision box and jammed shoulder_pan, and no point above its interior was inside the arm's workspace (packet M5/V1); it is also wholly inside the overhead camera's frustum at wall height, which tests/golden/render/so101_frame0.bin depends on; a free-joint `cube` body (`cube_free`, box half-extents 0.0125 0.0125 0.02, 0.05 kg, diagonal inertia computed for that box) nominally at (0.24, 0, 0.02); one fixed overhead `<camera name="overhead">` at (0.16, 0, 0.5); and one visual-only `ceiling_light` geom, whose `_light` name suffix is how crates/es-render/src/scene.rs infers an emitter. The cube deviates from upstream `scene_box.xml` (`size="0.02 0.02 0.03"` at `pos="0.5 0 0.03"`): it is smaller so the SO-101 jaws close on it -- 25 mm across, not 30: one jaw is fixed, and a 30 mm cube approached with the base yawed leaves about two millimetres of clearance, which the arm loses on the way down (packet M5/V1), and nearer so it is inside the arm's reach.
The file is flat: no `<include>`, no `<keyframe>`, no `<equality>`, no `<contact>`, no `<tendon>`, no `<sensor>`.
oracle: crates/es-assets/tests/so101_provenance.rs fetches upstream so101.xml at `commit` (from $ES_MENAGERIE_CACHE/<commit>/so101.xml, else `curl -fsSL` into target/), verifies `blake3_so101_xml` before parsing it, and asserts the kinematic equality above.
